stories.title: Hurts out for season after blood clots discovered in Eagles QB's lungs
stories.summary: Jalen Hurts will miss the rest of the season after doctors discovered multiple blood clots in the Eagles QB's lungs, according to NFL Network and ESPN.

stories.title: Colts fire GM Ballard after home loss to Titans, cite 'necessary' change
stories.summary: The Colts fired GM Chris Ballard one day after losing to the previously winless Titans. Owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon said "a change in leadership is necessary."

stories.title: Harbaugh mum on McDaniel, says Chargers need 'to address everything'
stories.summary: Jim Harbaugh said his Chargers will "have to address everything, and especially offensively" after another dismal performance in a 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.

stories.title: Oregon leading receiver Stewart arrested on DUI charge
stories.summary: Oregon wide receiver Evan Stewart was arrested early Sunday on a charge of driving under the influence of intoxicants.

stories.title: Sources: Falcons to sign QB Dalton, release QB Rush
stories.summary: The Falcons are signing quarterback Andy Dalton, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Monday, and are are releasing quarterback Cooper Rush, NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reported.
